events.title: 2026 Iran War - Strait of Hormuz Crisis Active
events.summary: US-Israel-Iran war ongoing. Iran closed Strait of Hormuz disrupting 20% of global oil supply. Ceasefire collapsed July 8 after Iran attacked commercial vessels. UN shipping agency paused evacuation effort after vessel attacked in Gulf of Oman (Aug 26). Trump posted image of waterway as New US Territory.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC Declared, Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC declared PHEIC by WHO on May 16-17 2026. As of Aug 21: 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections detected. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo strain. Spread to Uganda.

events.title: US Treasury Doubles Long-Bond Buybacks - Soft Financial Repression
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced at least doubling of long-duration bond buybacks (10Y-30Y sector) starting Sep 9. 30-year yield hit highest level in nearly 20 years. Combined with coordinated US-Japan yen intervention. Analysts warn of soft-form financial repression.

events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention - First in a Generation
events.summary: US and Japan executed rare coordinated FX intervention to stabilize yen in early August 2026. USD/JPY settled near 159. CNBC reports carry trade re-emerging. BOJ expected to hike rates Sep 18 (80% probability).

events.title: Fifth US Bank Failure of 2026 - Small Bank Closures Accelerating
events.summary: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank (Philadelphia, $68M assets) became 5th US bank failure of 2026, up from 2 in same period 2025. Systemic risk contained but regional stress building.

events.title: Oil Markets Under Strait of Hormuz Disruption Pressure
events.summary: EIA forecasts oil prices remain elevated until Hormuz flows normalize. Global inventories drawing down. Crude fell 3% to ~$82.5 on Aug 25 amid diplomatic progress signals. MCB Group compares to 1970s energy crisis. LNG volumes also disrupted.

summary: 6 breaking events detected across 12 domains. 2 category-5 (Iran war, Ebola PHEIC), 3 category-4 (Treasury buyback, oil disruption, yen intervention), 1 category-3 (bank failures).
